name: Autotune
author: DSP Toolbox
description: Pitch-correct a singing voice to the key of the backing track, with one Strength control. Output is mono on both channels.

paramHelp.strength: Low keeps the voice natural. High snaps every note: the robot effect.
paramHelp.key_source: Track reads the key from the loaded file. Manual uses the Key and Scale you choose.
paramHelp.ref_a4: The pitch of A4 for note names and correction. Most music uses 440 Hz.
paramHelp.note_hold: How far past the halfway point you must sing before the target moves to the next note.
paramHelp.voice_range: Limits which pitches count as singing. A narrower range avoids octave mistakes.
paramHelp.silence_db: Anything quieter than this passes through uncorrected.
